purpose: Exploratory registration of a distinct OKX+Binance (USDT) funding-dispersion estimand over the verified historical funding intersection of Binance USD-M futures and OKX USDT-swap perpetuals. This estimand is separately versioned from FVD-DISPERSION-V1, FVD-EXPLORATORY-001, and FVD-EXPLORATORY-002 (Hyperliquid+OKX). It does not modify the frozen grid, FVD001-FVD108, FVD053, or the original run_manifest.json.

estimand.description: Cross-venue funding-dispersion carry hypothesis restricted to the OKX|Binance USD-M pair, both of which settle funding in USDT. Distinct from the original FVD-DISPERSION-V1 estimand (market-cap-weighted universe) and from FVD-EXPLORATORY-002 (Hyperliquid+OKX, settlement unprovable).
estimand.settlement_currency: USDT (provable for both venues: OKX settleCcy=USDT verified via /public/instruments HTTP 200; Binance USD-M settles in USDT by definition + checksum-verified archive provenance)

contract_mapping_basis: underlying symbol match only (e.g. BTCUSDT <-> BTC-USDT-SWAP); instrument metadata cross-check, listing/delisting/lifecycle verification, and historical contract equivalence NOT independently verified via venue metadata or archive provenance
binding_constraint: instrument_identity_not_verified — contract identity between Binance USD-M futures (e.g. BTCUSDT) and OKX USDT-swap perpetuals (e.g. BTC-USDT-SWAP) is symbol-mapped only, not proven equivalent via lifecycle/listing metadata. Per exploratory_protocol_v1.md section 3 requirement 1 ('compatible contract identities'), this is not established. This is the binding constraint for this estimand, distinct from the settlement-currency match which IS provable.
anchor_result: NOT EXERCISED — data gate fails before anchor per exploratory_protocol_v1.md section 6 stop rule. Instrument identity is not provable (candidate-level, symbol-mapped only) and the OKX+Binance funding intersection is ~72 days (< 90-day prior-observation threshold for FVD053). The frozen anchor was not run.

cost_assumptions.note: frozen grid base scenario; sensitivity assumption, not a venue fee claim

sample_construction: Verified historical intersection of instruments with funding settlements + price history on >=2 venues over the OKX+Binance pair; no market-cap rank required for this distinct exploratory estimand; shorter history allowed; not market-cap representative.

coverage_summary.binance_funding_settlements: feasibility-assessed (6.82 years, 2020-01 to 2026-09; full download not performed)

data_gate_result: NOT_PASSED — settlement currency match is provable for OKX|Binance (both USDT), but contract identity/instrument identity is NOT provable (symbol-mapped only, candidate-level). Per exploratory_protocol_v1.md section 3 requirement 1, 'compatible contract identities' are required but not established (Hyperliquid meta exposes no settlement currency; Binance|Hyperliquid settlement unprovable; Binance|OKX instrument identity symbol-only). Additionally, the OKX+Binance funding intersection is ~72 days (2026-07-20 to 2026-09-30T16:00:00Z), below the 90-day prior-observation threshold for FVD053. Binance archive provides 6.82 years of history (meets 3-year depth), but Okx funding retention limits the intersection. No anchor run, no backtest, no performance metric.

threshold_history_eligibility.eligible_reason: Instrument identity not provable + funding intersection (72 days) below 90-day minimum

exclusion_rules: >=90 prior daily observations required for threshold
compatible contract identities required (NOT met — symbol-mapped only)
implementation_gate_result: Source-independent primitives covered by known-answer/adversarial tests and conformance validators; no real-data anchor run (data gate fails before anchor per exploratory protocol section 6 stop rule)
conclusion: EXPLORATORY_ONLY / INCONCLUSIVE for inference. The OKX+Binance (USDT) estimand registers a distinct exploratory estimand where the settlement-currency sub-component of contract identity IS provable (both venues settle in USDT). However, instrument/contract identity is NOT provable (symbol-mapped only, candidate-level) and the OKX+Binance funding intersection is ~72 days, below the 90-day prior-observation threshold for the FVD053 anchor. Per exploratory_protocol_v1.md section 6, contract identity is a required eligibility criterion that is not established; the gates fail before anchor. The frozen FVD053 anchor was NOT exercised. No backtest, no performance metric, no economic edge claimed. Confirmatory gate BLOCKED_DATA_GATE preserved.
next_step: Per exploratory_protocol_v1.md section 6 stop rule: instrument identity (contract identity) is the binding constraint, not settlement currency. The OKX+Binance funding intersection (~72 days) is also below the 90-day threshold. Do not fabricate or substitute data; preserve the confirmatory gate BLOCKED_DATA_GATE. Move to a bounded source-independent task (e.g. adversarial/equity tests on _latest_at_or_before, independent recomputation of existing anchor results, or schema/contract validation). If a free source route that proves instrument/lifecycle identity emerges, a new exploratory version may register it.
caveats: Free public sources lack >=3 years of historical point-in-time market-cap ranks with both effective/as-of and publication/availability timestamps; confirmatory gate remains BLOCKED_DATA_GATE.
This is a registry of the OKX+Binance (USDT) estimand only; no anchor run, no backtest, no performance metric claimed.

Settlement currency match IS provable for OKX|Binance (both USDT) via OKX /public/instruments (HTTP 200, settleCcy=USDT) and Binance USD-M archive provenance (checksum-verified, defined to settle in USDT).

Instrument/contract identity is NOT provable: Binance BTCUSDT vs OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP is symbol-mapped only; not independently verified via venue metadata or lifecycle events. This is the binding constraint for this estimand.

Binance USD-M archive provides 6.82 years of funding+price history (2020-01 to 2026-09, 8h funding interval matching OKX) — meets the 3-year depth requirement, but only checksum objects were verified, not the full archive downloaded.

OKX funding-rate-history retention is documented as 'up to three months'; the probe returned 296 rows with stop_reason=page_not_full, confirming the server holds no older records. The OKX+Binance funding intersection is ~72 days (2026-07-20 to 2026-09), below the 90-day prior-observation threshold for the FVD053 anchor.
No performance metric or economic edge claimed; EXPLORATORY_ONLY does not authorize live or paper trading.
FVD-EXPLORATORY-003 is INCONCLUSIVE for inference — data gates fail before anchor per exploratory_protocol_v1.md section 6 stop rule.
Survivorship bias, listing/delisting, and ticker-reuse handling for Binance USD-M futures are not assessed.
Current cap snapshots are discovery-only; no market-cap rank substituted for historical ranks in this exploratory estimand.
Modeled fees/slippage (base 5/5 bps) are sensitivity assumptions, not measured venue costs.
